text_simplified: Parents must raise their children upon righteousness and uprightness, and make du'a for them with goodness and barakah. They should also instill religious and moral values in their children's hearts from a young age. Giving attention to making du'a for one's children is one of the most important means of tarbiyah imaniyyah (faith-based upbringing).
